title: Infinite Hood — Cloud-Native Sovereign Territory
hood_objective: The cloud is infinite territory — we own plots (domains), populate them with cooking agents, and retain SA insight sovereignty via offline-first mesh.

kernel_vs_territory.kernel: Black Beast — development, logic, KPGS altar compile, local ledger
kernel_vs_territory.territory: Cloud plots — deployment, client ingress, scaled agent execution

sharded_sovereignty.rule: Never monolith 300 agents into one bucket — shard across domain portfolio as mesh nodes

cohort_roles_on_plot.landlord_guardian: One altar block holder per plot — discernment filter + hash-chain commit for that hood
cohort_roles_on_plot.telemetry_utility: Sense ground-aware traffic entering the plot
cohort_roles_on_plot.identic_utility: Jethro + forensic sociology + WWJD for client queries

cloud_backbone.azure_note: Geo-distributed clusters via partner fabric — LLM heavy lifting off Black Beast

data_residency.rule: Cloud reasons at scale; insights and ledger receipts anchor local/offline-first mesh

client_ingress.outer_layer: FastAPI /api/kc/phu + /api/kasilink — PWAs and partner shells land here

microsoft.note: Use giant machinery to build Kopano house — BFF targets context.kopanolabs.com

google.note: Workspace clients ingress to PWA ecosystem pre-loaded with Kopano Context API

parked_plot.display: Parked domain — landlord only until activated

no_dormant_agents.rule: If an agent is not cooking, it is a resource leak — SWFUS + Jethro sever or reassign to active plot
